caption:
Urban Outfitters is wrapping up its UO Game Day tour at Rutgers this weekend. Instead of a generic ad, they brought in different artists like Flo Milli for Rutgers and EDM for Arizona. When was the last time a brand actually got your campus vibe right? 🎒✨

Source: Marketing Dive

#UrbanOutfitters #MarketingStrategy #GenZMarketing #BrandCampaign #CollegeCulture

post.news: Urban Outfitters is wrapping up its third UO Game Day tour at Rutgers University, tailoring campus events from EDM to hip-hop.
post.take: Brands really studied college vibes harder than our final exams just to sell us cargo pants.
post.insight: Tailoring experiential marketing to distinct campus subcultures beats a one-size-fits-all ad every single time.
